title: Now (August 2026)
summary: What I'm doing now. August 2026 edition
content:
This update has been way too long - January was the last one. I kind of let weeknotes take over but they don't include the now part of a now page so I'm going to make an effort to update the now page every month while continuing with weeknotes in the sporadic fashion that I have been.

Doing...

  • We went to 4 Kingdoms which feels a bit more run down that some other places we've been but the Knightlings had a great time.
  • Baby Knight the second is starting at a new nursery next week which means both the Knightlings will be at the same place — this will make lunchtime pickups much easier.
  • I ordered a physical copy of Umbra because I want to try out a solo RPG and the idea of drawing a map as part of that really appeals to me. Had to order a mystery set of dice too, of course.
  • I want to do more (and get better at) drawing and incorporate that into my online things. Practice is the thing I hear that works. Sounds like a propaganda to sell more practice.
  • Prepping for the Relay and St Jude fundraiser with Adam. Sticker designs are coming along nicely, here's a peek at mine.

Making...

  • A new website design. This is taking a lot longer than I'd like because I just can't nail down the colour scheme.
  • A handful of small, single use tools similar to Doodle Scan and Favicons to Go.

Listening...

  • Connor Price and Nic D.
  • Lauren Sanderson's latest album, Lauren.
  • Zebrahead - O EP

Watching...

  • Superstore for the second time.
  • We just finished Paradise.
  • Up next on the list: Grey's season 22, Daredevil, Reacher season 4, and the new Futurama season.

Writing with...

  • Pink Lemonade TWSBI Eco 1.1 inked with Diamine Lady Grey
  • Pilot Prera stub nib inked with TPA Fire on Fire
  • Pilot Parallels
